test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of letter-clusters.

DKG : HSN

VLM : ZTT
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (4), (8) and (7) is added to first, second and third letters according to the position value according to the English alphabetic series respectively.​​

Given :

 
• DKG : HSN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea80dca7d1d4aabfb89c49568d60bdf9e691df71b33e29b87cb21c6d44a01cd4.png] 

 
• VLM : ZTT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2759788f5976e6c2f84048f7ceed67d781d0509c75c2e0fb67eacb6fbbc52265.png] 

So,​

 
• Option - (1) : RBI : VYG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ebfa2f01990b0e3c99272e92f6aea29fc2110e574897860ead28003342def16.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : SPY : VXB

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84088e92f6ba2d726fab0b0c6d3b96a97568a6183ae7095f45668e729386d18e.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : KTY : OBF

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fa8b42f2ff4f6e8cda09b62015b2fecda99d18ecd4aac57ae20f04fa6f0ec18.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : PBN : SLM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/881ba6a0dbf13d3effbf36bc97d6db4980c96db66f81a707ed04cd688854158c.png] 

Here, out of all options only '**KTY : OBF**' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "**Option - (3)**" is the correct answer.
